common_flow: Open the site and search for the user query.
On results, identify job postings by title and company.
Visit visible unvisited cards in a stable top-to-bottom order.
On detail, scroll through the job detail body until major requirement sections are collected.

collection_policy.finish_condition: Requested trend sample size is reached or no useful unvisited cards remain.

known_pitfalls: Some detail content can be embedded or protected in ways that make DOM extraction hard; the vision runner should collect visible sections directly.
Search result cards include many badges that should not be treated as the selected job identity.
